notes: Cleaner update notification. The top banner no longer dumps the whole changelog — it now just says 'Update available: vX.Y.Z (you have v…)' with three buttons: What's new, Install Now, Dismiss. 'What's new' opens a tidy feature-report popup that breaks the release notes into bullet points, with the version and date. The Settings → App Updates section gets a matching 'What's new' button and no longer crams notes into the status line. EN + JA. index.html only.
